meta.title: Sadaf Residence — Bekabad
meta.description: A residential complex of 12- and 16-storey buildings: a car-free courtyard, a playground and shops on the ground floor. Choose your apartment online.

common.sample: Sample data: prices and statuses will be replaced with the sales team's list.

home.lead: 12- and 16-storey buildings, a car-free enclosed courtyard, a playground and shops on the ground floor. Choose your apartment right here.
home.aboutTitle: Homes in the city, far from its noise
home.aboutP1: The complex has three building types: a 12-storey single-entrance, a 12-storey two-entrance and a 16-storey five-entrance building. They enclose the courtyard, so it stays quiet and safe inside.
home.aboutP2: Lower floors are clad in brick, upper floors in light render. Balconies have patterned screens. Shops and services face the street on the ground floor.
home.step1t: Tap a floor on the facade — available apartments appear instantly.
home.step2t: Plan, area, price and an instalment estimate on one page.
home.step3t: A manager calls back within 15 minutes and invites you to a viewing.
home.tourText: Walk from the street past the shops, courtyard, playground and buildings. Tap the golden dots — the camera takes you there.
home.film1Text: The courtyard between the buildings is for people only. Parking is outside, along the street.
home.film2Text: The playground sits in the middle of the courtyard, visible from the windows.
home.film3Text: Shrubs line the paths, with arched entrances and shady trees. Quiet and clean.
home.film4Text: Street-facing ground floor with large shop windows and services.
home.film5Text: Every apartment has a balcony. Patterned screens give shade and a local touch.
home.featLead: Three buildings enclose the courtyard: quiet inside, children in sight, daily shopping a few steps away.
home.f2t: Fenced and visible from the windows.
home.f3t: Retail and services on the street side with separate entrances.
home.f4t: Car spaces along the street; no cars in the courtyard.
home.f5t: Patterned screens shade it from the sun.
home.f6t: Brick lower floors, light render above.
home.i1t: Footpaths, shrubs and trees across the courtyard.
home.i2t: Fenced and visible from the buildings.
home.i3t: On the street side, with separate entrances.
home.i4t: Car spaces along the buildings, on the street side.
home.i5t: Enter the courtyard through flower beds and arches.
home.i6t: Easy access to entrances from the courtyard.
home.plansLead: Four layouts on every floor. Pick a type to see available apartments and prices.
home.ctaTitle: Would you like to live at Sadaf Residence?
home.ctaText: Fill in the form — a manager will call within 15 minutes with available apartments and prices.
home.payLead: Pick a down payment and term to see the monthly payment instantly. A manager confirms the exact terms.
home.payAvg: Estimate based on the average 2-room apartment price
home.galHint: Tap a picture to open it full screen. Use arrows or swipe.

b12a.name: 12-storey, single-entrance building
b12a.text: A compact single-entrance building. The two lower floors are brick, the upper ones light render. Every apartment has a balcony; corner units look two ways.

b12b.name: 12-storey, two-entrance building
b12b.text: The longer two-entrance building closes one side of the courtyard. Courtyard-side apartments overlook the playground and greenery.

b16.name: 16-storey, five-entrance building
b16.text: The tallest building of the complex. Shops face the street on the ground floor; upper floors open onto city views.

hero.p: The 16-storey building is the complex's highest point. To its left are the 12-storey buildings.

street.t: A wide street and a green strip
street.p: A two-lane road along the buildings, trees and lawns.

shops.p: Shops with display windows face the street, each with its own entrance.

facade.p: Every apartment has a balcony. The screens give shade and a local touch to the facade.

yard.p: The courtyard between the buildings is for people only: paths, shrubs and trees.

play.p: The playground sits in the middle of the courtyard; parents can watch from the balcony.

arch.p: You enter the courtyard through arches and flower beds. Behind is the 12-storey single-entrance building.

aerial.p: The playground is in the centre, parking stays outside — no cars in the courtyard.

back.p: The rear of the 12-storey building faces a wide lawn and trees.

shops.p: The street-facing ground floor is fully commercial: large windows, separate entrances and steps. Daily shopping is a few steps from home.

parking.p: Cars park on the streets around the buildings. No cars enter the courtyard, so children play safely.

play.p: A fenced playground in the middle of the courtyard: soft surfacing, a tower play set and swings. Visible from the windows.

entr.p: Entrances open onto the courtyard. A ramp beside the steps makes it easy with a pram.

units.p: Every apartment has a balcony; patterned screens shade it from the sun. Choose a floor to see available apartments.
